checks: Default control prioritizes cargo and price table with inline charts; no map or cargo 3D mounted
Selecting a quote does not mutate ledger; prefill, unit price, quantity, cancel and explicit partial sale preserve cargo identity and freight
Map and cargo mount independently only when requested and unmount on close
Advisor, inventory groups/tags, ledger, backups and cloud entry remain available; reload preserves ledger
Failed public-price refresh retains references and does not change actual trades
Short desktop and English mobile have no page overflow; empty ledger can browse local purchases and hand inputs to planner
Buyer recalculation preserves the active ledger and does not pretend to constrain buyers to a destination
